title: Pull from the source without hurting it

hotspots.label: Retries
hotspots.detail: The HTTP client retries 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504; everything else fails immediately. The default max_attempts=2 is one retry. Raise it to 4 or 5 against APIs that rate-limit aggressively.

hotspots.label: Pacing
hotspots.detail: The rate limiter is proactive; retries are reactive. Run below the source quota: at 600 per minute, 7 to 8 per second leaves room for retries.

hotspots.label: Paging
hotspots.detail: Cursor paging stops when the cursor is missing, empty, not a string, or identical to the previous cursor. Offset pagination is unstable while the source is written to. Any loop you write must terminate on a misbehaving source.

hotspots.label: Logs
hotspots.detail: Query parameters are redacted in request logs by default. Redaction covers logging only.
